result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`. It compiles and the module builds offline, but I could not run the command end to end, so the behaviour is verified by reading the code only.

Changes:
- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` name and description. It is listed in the no-argument usage overview next to `updateLandscape`, with the same options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to `updateLandscape`, which now takes the typed command name and description. `-help` therefore prints the usage under the name the user typed, and `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own usage.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Landscape report" section covering `analyzeLandscape` and `updateLandscape`, rather than editing an existing list.

Verification: `mvn -o -pl cli test` succeeds, but the cli module has no tests. I then ran `mvn -o -pl cli package -DskipTests` to rebuild the jar. Running the jar to check `analyzeLandscape -help` was blocked as needing approval, so I did not run it.

I did not commit.
